entry_thesis: Bitcoin holding above $71,680 with institutional accumulation accelerating — IBIT absorbed $306.6M in a single session on March 4 and $1.47B in net inflows over two weeks, reversing 5 consecutive weeks of outflows. This is the cleanest ETF expression of BTC momentum with BlackRock's institutional distribution network driving sustained demand. IBIT's prior day-1 return of +10.51% confirmed the inflow reversal thesis and institutional buyers are adding on every dip.
risk: BTC is down ~3.6% on the session suggesting near-term consolidation after the sharp rebound from $60K lows; if macro risk-off returns or ETF inflows stall, IBIT could retrace toward $38.
catalyst: Continued spot Bitcoin ETF institutional inflows ($1.47B over 2 weeks), BTC holding above $70K support, March 18 FOMC decision expected neutral-to-dovish, DC Blockchain Summit and Digital Asset Summit in NYC driving institutional narrative in March.
